'''Vanahame''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. During the [[Republic Dark Age]], Vanahame was part of the [[Odionate]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] rump state ruled by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]]. The moon also housed a [[Odionate cloister|Cloister]], a large planet-sized orphanage where [[Youngling/Legends|children]] throughout the Odionate were indoctrinated into slaves and warriors for Odion's war effort. There were twelve such other facilities scattered throughout the Odionate. The moon had no atmosphere, but consisted of a large spaceport which housed the Cloister underneath.

Following the [[Capture of Skarpos|First Battle of Skarpos]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], Odion's naval commander [[Beld Yulan]]'s fleet stopped at the moon to replenish their ammunition stocks prior to traveling to [[Jubalene]], Odion's temporary throne world, and then [[Invasion of Sarrassia|invading]] of [[Sarrassia/Legends|Sarrassia]]. Following the [[Massacre on Skarpos|Second Battle of Skarpos]], Odion returned to Vanahame with the newly-acquired [[Helm of Ieldis]], an ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] capable of driving [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings into a homicidal frenzy. He intended to use the grief and misery of the child inmates at the Cloister to unleash the Helm on a galactic level; however, he was defeated by his enemy, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] who succeeded in convincing his second in command, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Beld Yulan]], to turn against him during the [[Battle of Vanahame]]. They freed the captive children and the subsequent rush of positive emotions caused the Helm to overload, killing Odion. After Odion's [[Death/Legends|death]], the territories of the Odionate were divided up between the other members of the [[Calimondra family]].
